text:
Sam: heads-up  we had three field asks this week about upgrade SLAs and cert rotation during private deploy upgrades. want to align on what to promise in v1.
Diego: can we avoid cert churn by keeping existing listener certs and just rotating backend keys? that reduces customer blast radius.
Priya: for customers using egress IP allowlists, cert rotation isn't the issue  it's endpoint IP and port changes. we should guarantee the control-plane won't change external endpoint during upgrade unless customer ACKs.
Hannah: customers also want transparent telemetry for upgrades (events: start, canary_complete, rollback, complete) shipped to their audit log endpoint. small request but high impact for compliance teams.
Sam: proposed v1 commitments: 1) preserve external endpoint hostname & port through upgrade by default, 2) grace-window (48h) to keep old pods reachable, 3) emit upgrade lifecycle events to customer webhook + control-plane audit log. exclude auto-managed DNS updates.
Diego: implementation note  agent will create a shadow listener that proxies to new instance and keep old listener active until COMPLETE or grace-window expires. overhead small but simpler for rollback.
Priya: caveat  for on-prem installs behind strict firewalls we need an explicit "endpoint-stability" config bit so agent doesn't try tunneling. will add to config schema.
Hannah: on telemetry: need schema for events. suggest {event, timestamp, job_id, phase, result, fingerprint}. also need opt-in flag for customers who don't want webhooks.
Sam: agree. also we should define SLO language: "we aim to perform non-breaking upgrades without endpoint change in 99% of cases for customers who use default config". that's soft but honest. legal can word it later.
Diego: timeline: I can prototype the shadow-listener + event emit in 3 weeks. will need test harness to simulate mid-upgrade route changes.
Priya: I'll draft the endpoint-stability config options and firewall guidance doc. also call out NAT patterns and when a static proxy is required.
Hannah: I'll coordinate with CS to collect sample audit webhook endpoints from pilot customers. need at least one FedRAMP-ish customer for compliance checks.
ops-bot: note created: upgrade-lifecycle-events-v1 (ticket 4721).
Sam: open questions: how do we handle TLS cert renewal? do we automate Let's Encrypt for customer domains? probably not in v1.
Diego: no LE in v1. we should support customer-provided cert bundle and a manual rotate command in CLI: `rwdctl cert rotate --service svc-a --cert-file /path/pem`
Priya: and add a cert-verify step in the verification harness that checks SANs and expiration > 30 days post-upgrade.
Hannah: pilots: prefer to run on two customers with different network topologies (GCP shared-VPC, AWS private link). will start outreach.
Sam: owners/actions:
- Diego: prototype shadow listener + emit events (due 2025-11-10)
- Priya: draft endpoint-stability config + firewall guidance (due 2025-11-12)
- Hannah: collect pilot candidates + webhook schema examples (due 2025-11-07)
- Sam: write SLO/commit language + add to launch checklist (due 2025-11-05)

Sam: thanks all. will drop a one-pager and link it here when ready. :rocket:
